newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Arenas - labour reform no panacea.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Arenas - labour reform no panacea.

text.p: Spanish Labour Minister Javier Arenas said on Tuesday a labour reform accord reached between unions and employers would not be a remedy for high unemployment but would eliminate obstacles to job creation.

"Whoever thinks labour reform is going to be a panacea for employment is wrong. (Labour reform) must be understood as the elimination of obstacles to creating employment," the minister said in a debate at the Institute of Economic Studies in Madrid.
Spanish unemployment, above 21 percent, is the highest in the European Union.
Last week, employers and unions agreed on a reform which would make it cheaper to fire workers in exchange for an increase in numbers of permanent contracts.
Arenas praised the accord as a far-reaching and sufficient reform.
